final_briefs.title: xiaobai-kanban
final_briefs.description: **Turn natural‑language commands into working code with the Xiaobai Kanban AI assistant.** The project offers a Chinese‑language tutorial that walks you through agents, CLI setup, and Git workflows, letting you speak to an Agent that writes a web page for you and handles version control automatically.
final_briefs.why_it_matters: An AI coding assistant that turns natural‑language commands into code and automates Git workflows, cutting the friction between idea and implementation.
final_briefs.who_cares: Frontend, backend, and full‑stack developers who want to boost productivity with AI‑driven tooling.

final_briefs.title: Authentication and Authorization: What's New in .NET 11
final_briefs.description: **.NET 11 lets SignalR keep live connections alive while refreshing expired tokens.** The new `EnableAuthenticationRefresh` option adds a `/refresh` endpoint so a client can swap its `ClaimsPrincipal` without dropping the hub, eliminating downtime for long‑running real‑time apps.
final_briefs.why_it_matters: .NET 11’s SignalR authentication refresh eliminates token‑expiry downtime, tightening security while keeping real‑time connections alive.
final_briefs.who_cares: .NET backend developers and security engineers building real‑time services.

final_briefs.title: oink
final_briefs.description: **Oink turns multiple Macs and PCs into a single seamless workstation.** This peer‑to‑peer KVM layer lets you share keyboard, mouse, trackpad, clipboard, drag‑and‑drop, and audio across devices, with automatic local‑network discovery and encrypted traffic.
final_briefs.why_it_matters: Oink creates a seamless cross‑platform KVM, letting teams share a single mouse, keyboard, and clipboard across Macs and PCs without extra hardware.
final_briefs.who_cares: DevOps, sysadmins, and remote teams that need instant, secure device sharing.

final_briefs.title: One SKILL.md, Many Agents: Writing Agent Skills That Work in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Hermes
final_briefs.description: **One SKILL.md file now powers workflows in Claude, Codex, Cursor, and dozens of other agents.** The open‑standard format requires only a `SKILL.md` with metadata and instructions, letting you write a skill once and reuse it across many AI‑agent tools.
final_briefs.why_it_matters: A single SKILL.md format works across Claude, Codex, Cursor, and more, so you write one workflow and reuse it everywhere.
final_briefs.who_cares: AI tool integrators and developers building multi‑agent pipelines.

final_briefs.title: Build a file-sharing app with presigned uploads: Storage, Auth and Postgres over one MCP connection
final_briefs.description: **Follow an AI‑guided tutorial to build a presigned‑upload file‑sharing service in a single MCP connection.** The three‑part series shows how to set up storage, authentication, and Postgres, handling large uploads without hitting server size limits, all orchestrated by an AI coding agent.
final_briefs.why_it_matters: A step‑by‑step guide to presigned uploads and a single MCP connection shows how to build a scalable file‑sharing backend with AI assistance.
final_briefs.who_cares: Full‑stack developers and startup founders building cloud‑native file services.
